notes.note: Only 2 of 12 business data flows are enabled: Create POA Main For Automated Joining and Create POA Main For Pension Joining. The other 10 executables (Active POA, Cancel Active POA, Cancel Duplicate waiting POA, Canncel POA main, the four future-funds flows, Create POA MAIN For Transfer Request, Out of Date) have DTS:Disabled="True"; their writers are mapped with disabled:true and are NOT active writes.
15 of the 33 CRM writers are ETL plumbing (14 ETL Warning scripts writing gen_etlprocesswarning, End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish) and are not mapped.

AJ: rows matching 'Check If POA Of Customer Account Exists' (Match output unconnected) and Bet1 rows not redirected by 'If POA period merge' (Output 0 unconnected) are never marked gen_testedtocreatepoa → re-read every run. Conversely every row entering 'Create POA Main' is marked tested, even when the script ignored it (NULL agent+agency, dedup) or the create failed (sync Success output).

AJ 'If POA period merge' main.cs:132 compares the AJ agent LICENSE number with the existing POA main's AGENCY identity (Row.genagencyidentity) instead of the agent identity (Row.genagentidentity) checked one line earlier — likely a bug.

PJ 'Check If Exist POA' matches the POA main's agent identity / agency account number (isnull(contact.gen_identitynumber, account.AccountNumber)) against the pension joining's agent/agency LICENSE number (ISNULL(Gen_agents.Gen_LicenseNumber, Gen_agencie.Gen_licenseNumber)); the AJ lookups use contact identity / account number on both sides.

Date handling differs per attribute: SQL adds +3h (and truncates some to date); scripts then apply ToLocalTime() to gen_signaturedate/gen_receivingdate/gen_startdate, but not to gen_enddate (AJ) or counseling dates. TR uses AddHours(3) on raw dates but AddYears(10) without +3h for gen_enddate.
AJ gen_name: Bet1 prefix "נספח ב'1" has no space before the customer name, Bet2 "נספח ב'2 " has one.

AJ Create POA Main reads CurrentCustomeraccountId, gen_accountname, createdby, gen_customeraccount1-7, gen_additionalaccountsexists1-6, gen_ifpowerofattorneyvalidforadditionalaccoun, gen_bankaccountnumber, gen_agencylicensenumber and gen_agentlicensenumber but never writes them to CRM (AdditionalAccounts set is built and unused; createdby assignment commented out).

TR Create POA Main (disabled): input gen_signaturedate is unused; gen_agencyname/gen_agentname are EntityReferences with logical names gen_agencie/gen_agents while AJ/PJ use account/contact for the same attributes; an annotation failure prevents the Success row → transfer request not marked → POA main re-created next run.

Pension joinings that never get gen_createpoamain = 3 — skipped by Check If Poa Attached (later rows of an identity fall through main.cs:47/67), ignored by Create POA Main (main.cs:324-328), failed creates, or rows matching nothing downstream — keep gen_createpoamain = 1 and are re-read every run.

PJ source is SELECT DISTINCT joined to Contact by identity number; the AJ source joins gen_customeraccount by padded bank account — duplicates are possible (AJ: first row per AJ id kept; PJ Get-POA-Main No-Match branch: no dedup, one create per row).

Future-funds creators: providant-allow-info and studing-allow-info scripts are byte-identical (sha a9a9428199aa) but differ upstream (SQL: gen_excludeprovidentfunds/gen_type 1 vs gen_exclludetrainingfunds/gen_type 2); allow-action variants have a POAMainOrder == 1 split and gen_currentstate = 1, allow-info variants have no split and gen_currentstate = startdate > now ? 3 : 1; batch sizes 10 (providant-allow-action) vs 1000.
Script sources analysed; compiled DLLs not decompiled (CLAUDE.md rule 12). Lookup partial-cache semantics are described from SqlCommandParam + join columns.
